source: Copied from the iOS app (app/Data/MysteryData.swift: names and traditionalFruits; app/Data/MysteriesInScriptureData.swift: keyVerses, split on ' — ', and sevenGraces) on 4 October 2026. Never edited by hand: it is what the app shows.

mysteries.name: The Annunciation
mysteries.key_verse: Behold thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and shalt bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name Jesus.

mysteries.name: The Visitation
mysteries.key_verse: Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

mysteries.name: The Nativity
mysteries.key_verse: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him up in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger.

mysteries.name: The Presentation
mysteries.key_verse: Now thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord, according to thy word in peace; because my eyes have seen thy salvation.

mysteries.name: The Finding in the Temple
mysteries.key_verse: Did you not know, that I must be about my father's business?

mysteries.name: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.key_verse: My Father, if it be possible, let this chalice pass from me. Nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

mysteries.name: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.key_verse: Then therefore, Pilate took Jesus, and scourged him.

mysteries.name: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.key_verse: And platting a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head.

mysteries.name: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.key_verse: And bearing his own cross, he went forth to that place which is called Calvary.

mysteries.name: The Crucifixion
mysteries.key_verse: Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit.

mysteries.name: The Resurrection
mysteries.key_verse: He is not here, for he is risen, as he said.

mysteries.name: The Ascension
mysteries.key_verse: And the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven, and sitteth on the right hand of God.

mysteries.name: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.key_verse: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they began to speak with divers tongues.

mysteries.name: The Assumption
mysteries.key_verse: He that is mighty hath done great things to me; and holy is his name.

mysteries.name: The Coronation
mysteries.key_verse: And a great sign appeared in heaven: A woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

mysteries.name: The Baptism in the Jordan
mysteries.key_verse: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

mysteries.name: The Wedding at Cana
mysteries.key_verse: Whatsoever he shall say to you, do ye.

mysteries.name: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
mysteries.key_verse: The time is accomplished, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent, and believe the gospel.

mysteries.name: The Transfiguration
mysteries.key_verse: And he was transfigured before them. And his face did shine as the sun.

mysteries.name: The Institution of the Eucharist
mysteries.key_verse: Take ye, and eat. This is my body.

mysteries.name: The Prophecy of Simeon
mysteries.key_verse: And thy own soul a sword shall pierce, that, out of many hearts, thoughts may be revealed.

mysteries.name: The Flight into Egypt
mysteries.key_verse: Arise, and take the child and his mother, and fly into Egypt.

mysteries.name: The Loss of Jesus in the Temple
mysteries.key_verse: Son, why hast thou done so to us? behold thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

mysteries.name: Mary Meets Jesus Carrying the Cross
mysteries.key_verse: And there followed him a great multitude of people, and of women, who bewailed and lamented him.

mysteries.name: The Crucifixion
mysteries.key_verse: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus, his mother.

mysteries.name: Jesus Taken Down from the Cross
mysteries.key_verse: Joseph of Arimathea... came and took away the body of Jesus.

mysteries.name: The Burial of Jesus
mysteries.key_verse: Now there was in the place where he was crucified, a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre... There, therefore, they laid Jesus.

seven_graces: Consolation in their pains, and her companionship in their work.
Whatever they ask, so long as it accords with God's will and the good of their souls.
Defence in their spiritual battles, and protection at every instant of their lives.
Visible help at the moment of death — they will see the face of their Mother.
Her Son's mercy for those who spread this devotion, that they may be brought from this life to eternal happiness.
